clips.title: The story
paras: Murloc tribes and hungry sea creatures crowd the Twilight Shore in southern Darkshore. The rugged coast runs from the Long Wash to Ashenvale, where misty beaches meet cliffs, islets, and dangerous surf.

The Twilight Shore runs south from the Long Wash, past Ameth'Aran's ruins, toward Ashenvale. Gray beaches give way to sharp cliffs and rocky islands. Threshadons and sea crawlers prowl the waters, while aggressive murloc camps line the shore.
